meta.description: Run personal AI agents with a Go backend: separate processes, SQLite chat history, workspaces, tools and channels. Add the Node.js web dashboard separately.

hero.body: A Go backend for personal AI agents, each with a process, SQLite chat history, workspace, tools and channels. The web dashboard runs separately on Node.js.

loop.title: A run is a conversation with consequences.
loop.body: A message starts a run: context is assembled, the model responds, and tools can act in the workspace. Your approval policy determines which calls need a decision.
loop.example_note: Illustrative spans, timings, token counts and costs — not a live run or actual billing.
loop.note_1_body: Enable optional observability to inspect recorded tool calls, timings and token usage for supported runs. Inspection does not re-execute a run.
loop.note_2_body: Chat history is stored in SQLite. Context and notes such as MEMORY.md can be read and updated through file tools; they are not automatic semantic recall.
loop.note_3_body: Configure manual or off mode, allowlists, saved grants and unattended behaviour. Not every tool call waits for a human.

fleet.title: One machine. More than one cat.
fleet.body: Run agents as separate processes, each with its own port, database, workspace, skills and channels. They still share the host and its permissions — a separate process is not a security sandbox.
fleet.example_note: Sample agents, PIDs, run counts and uptime — not telemetry from your host.

doors.title: More ways to reach your agent.
doors.body: Connect through messaging channels, the terminal, the web dashboard or your own client. Chat history stays scoped to its conversation and channel, not one shared thread everywhere.
doors.discord: Discord bot — configure a token and channel permissions
doors.web: Separate Node.js app — connects to the control plane API
doors.heartbeat: Scheduled checks when enabled, while the host and agent service are running

rules.title: Small enough to read. Yours to keep.
rules.body: Myaaw is a personal tool with a few opinions. These are the ones that shaped it.
rules.item_1_body: The Go binary includes SQLite, queues, schedulers and backend servers. Add provider credentials and configure what you use; the Node.js dashboard is separate.
rules.item_2_body: Separate processes make agents easier to manage independently. Tools use host permissions; process separation is not a security boundary.
rules.item_3_body: Local state defaults to ~/.myaaw. Cloud providers and external tools can send prompts, files or other data off the host.
rules.item_4_title: Skills you can read and extend.
rules.item_4_body: Define each skill at skills/<name>/SKILL.md inside the agent directory. Skills can run scripts that need installed runtimes, dependencies and host permissions.
rules.item_5_body: An enabled heartbeat checks HEARTBEAT.md while the host and agent service are running. It cannot wake a powered-off host or guarantee completion.
rules.item_6_body: Reach an agent through Telegram, Discord, terminal or HTTP. SQLite chat history follows conversation and channel scope, not a universal shared memory.

capabilities.title: Start with the core. Connect what you need.
capabilities.body: Built-in capabilities come with the backend. Connected services and extensions need setup; availability also depends on your host and configuration.
capabilities.provider_body: Use Gemini or an OpenAI-compatible API key, or sign in with ChatGPT Subscription. Available models and image input depend on the provider. Subscription usage follows plan limits and does not silently switch to API-key billing.
capabilities.tools_body: Use Bash, Python and file tools on the host. Install required runtimes and dependencies; access depends on host permissions and tool policy.
capabilities.extensions_body: Extend instructions with SKILL.md, add executable custom tools, or connect stdio MCP servers. Scripts and servers need trusted code and installed dependencies.
capabilities.delegation_body: Manage separate agent processes, delegate tasks to subagents, or connect over A2A to a configured, running peer. These are distinct ways to coordinate work.
capabilities.schedule_body: Configure schedules or enable heartbeat checks. Both need a running host and agent service; scheduled work is not guaranteed to finish.
capabilities.backup_body: Create and restore tar.gz archives, optionally including workspace and logs. Secrets are included by default. --no-secrets omits known secret fields; inspect any archive before sharing.
capabilities.computer_note: Native desktop control is opt-in and currently implemented for macOS. It requires the relevant system permissions and installed dependencies.

closing.body: Download the backend and launch onboarding. Add a provider API key or sign in with ChatGPT Subscription locally, then start the agent service, control plane API and optional web dashboard separately.
closing.install_hint: Release workflow targets Linux x86_64 and macOS Apple Silicon.

steps.install_body: The installer downloads the backend and launches onboarding. Have an API key ready, or use a local browser to sign in with ChatGPT Subscription.
steps.agent_body: Run myaaw server start to start the agent service. Installation alone does not start it.
steps.api_body: Run myaaw api start separately for dashboard access. The installer does not start this API.
steps.dashboard_body: Use a source checkout and Node.js 22+. In webui/, run npm install, npm run build, then node build. See the setup guide for API connection settings.

closing.signature: Built quietly, for one loud mind.
